summary: Fresh independent canonical audit of all 374 Chinese units, 67 temporal or active-hint items, and ten people after Jinshi 042 curation. The repaired surrounding-narrative, quoted-precedent, and retrospective records no longer assert unsupported personal intervals. Shizong’s distinct explicit Dading 6 (AD 1166) events remain intact. The chapter cannot date the remaining undated policy, thanksgiving, Zhenzong-precedent, and retrospective-sacrifice contexts further, so this complete review records them as research holds rather than granting date approval.
